name: markdown-base64-embed
description: Automatically convert pasted or dropped images into inline Base64 Markdown embeds.

markdownBase64Embed.targetFormat.markdownDescription: Target image format for embedded Base64 strings. Choose `webp` to significantly reduce file size and character bloat.

markdownBase64Embed.quality.markdownDescription: Compression quality for lossy formats (`webp` or `jpeg`). Higher values retain quality; lower values reduce character length.

markdownBase64Embed.defaultAltText.description: Default alt text inserted into the Markdown image syntax.
